statCard.name: Hawkeye
statCard.artist: Patrick Brown, Gary Daniels III, and Alex Trip

attacks.name: Arrow Shot
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Full Quiver|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§poison§Poison|, |§shock§Shock|, or |§slow§Slow|.

superPowers.name: Hook Arrow
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Trick Shot
superPowers.body: The next |*Arrow Shot| attack this character makes ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.

superPowers.name: Fast Draw
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, if the attacker is not within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. This character immediately makes an |*Arrow Shot| attack targeting the attacking character.
